# [STORY] As an operator, I want an in-app admin view and a real Kibana dashboard suite, so that observability data is actually usable day-to-day, not just theoretically collected

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** an in-app admin view and a real Kibana dashboard suite
**So that** observability data is actually usable day-to-day, not just theoretically collected

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given an admin logs in, when they open the Admin Dashboard, then they see live Eureka/Gateway/Kibana/metrics links
- [x] Given an operator opens Kibana, when they need to inspect logs across services, then a professional multi-dashboard suite with alerting is available

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Notes
Retrofitted 2026-08-03 as part of the Scrum backlog rewrite, grouping pre-existing Tasks under a Story layer that didn't exist when they were implemented.

All three Tasks closed and verified: #70 (ADMIN-only dashboard with live Eureka/Gateway/Kibana/metrics links), #71 (Kibana Lens suite — Service Health, Error Triage, Per-Service Deep-Dive, with alerting), #112 (Kibana homepage plus `defaultRoute`, verified against a live local Kibana).

This Story's own diff is infra config, not Java, so the Java-specific gates don't apply to it directly — each child Task met its own gates when it closed.
